description: Source code for Bluetooth Audio shell commands related to ISO (Isochronous Streams) in Zephyr RTOS, including functions for creating, managing, and testing ISO channels, BIG (Broadcast Isochronous Group), and BIS (Broadcast Isochronous Stream).

methods.name: get_next_sn
methods.description: Calculates the next sequence number for ISO data packets based on last sequence number and timing.

methods.name: iso_connected
methods.description: Handles ISO channel connection event, initializes sequence number and timestamp.

methods.name: parse_interval
methods.description: Parses interval value from shell input.

methods.name: parse_latency
methods.description: Parses latency value from shell input.

methods.name: cmd_cig_create
methods.description: Creates a Connected Isochronous Group (CIG) with specified parameters.

methods.name: cmd_connect
methods.description: Initiates connection to an ISO channel.

methods.name: iso_accept
methods.description: Handles incoming ISO connection requests as peripheral.

methods.name: cmd_listen
methods.description: Sets up ISO channel listening as peripheral.

methods.name: cmd_send
methods.description: Sends data over an ISO channel.

methods.name: cmd_tx_sync_read_cis
methods.description: Reads TX sync info for CIS.

methods.name: cmd_broadcast
methods.description: Starts broadcasting on ISO channels as broadcaster.

methods.name: cmd_tx_sync_read_bis
methods.description: Reads TX sync info for BIS.

methods.name: cmd_big_sync
methods.description: Synchronizes to a BIG as receiver.
